about: The expected values of the two wrapping chains this capability carries, one entry per skill.
Every number here is quoted from the Reference run section of the concept named in `concept`,
in the nasa-daac-knowledge nsidc bundle. This capability computes nothing and owns none of these
numbers: the fixture exists so the golden fails when a chain stops reproducing what the concept
records, not so that a number can be asserted here.
The run identifier of a run is bound to the runtime name, so it is deliberately not asserted;
the values below are the same under any runtime name.
Each chain also names a run on the bundle's committed data root. Both of those runs refuse, so the
golden asserts a refusal there rather than a number: the closure refuses Antarctica for want of a
grounded firn air content term, and the input-output computation's record run refuses because the
thickness term is not in its root. Neither refusal is an error, and neither is smoothed here.

chains.quoted_from: the concept's Reference run section, the second fixture run at seed 7, Greenland over 2003-01 through 2016-12 on the itslive altimetry term

refusal.quoted_from: the concept's Reference run section, the refusal case the chain exercises on the fixture

record.quoted_from: the concept's Reference run section and its Boundaries section: the Antarctic refusal is exercised on the committed root, for want of a grounded firn air content term
record.about: a finding about the data, not an error: the firn distribution carries model output over the floating shelves only, so no grounded firn air content term covers the Antarctic altimetry domain

chains.quoted_from: the concept's Reference run section, the first fixture run at seed 7, Greenland over 2005-01 through 2014-12 on the gate set synthetic-outlets

refusal.quoted_from: the concept's Reference run section, the refusal the check chain exercises on the fixture

record.quoted_from: the concept's Reference run section: the real-data run is a refusal, not a number
record.about: no real-data input-output estimate exists: the thickness term sits behind a host the drafting environment's egress policy refuses, and no NASA archive distributes a gridded surface mass balance over grounded ice
